First-ever screen for tungsten-black-mass-lock-in (chain-level, scenario_id null; no prior data/screens/tungsten-black-mass-lock-in.json existed). This chain was built and mapped outside the campaign slate (data/mappings/tungsten-black-mass-lock-in.json's own notes[] and data/chains/tungsten-black-mass-lock-in.json both state it was run outside the ten-theme slate), so campaign_ref is null, matching the nodule-mining-refining precedent.

The mapping (data/mappings/tungsten-black-mass-lock-in.json, 7 issuers, 14 placements across 11 links) is status ACTIVE with an EMPTY audit block (never run), so it has no current PASS census audit and every row on this chain must rest on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted when the consumed placement's evidence is entirely VERIFIED, or a current PASS placement_audits[] entry exists for that exact (chain_id, link_id, issuer_id). Six fresh-context placement_audits[] entries landed today (2026-09-14): 5 FAIL (ABAT/recycling, AQMS/recycling, KMT/recycling, KMT/us-tungsten-processing, PKX/recycling) and 1 PASS (ELBM/recycling). Every one of the 5 FAILs is a composite-quote contiguity defect the auditor's own text calls non-fabricated and role-supporting (a punctuation substitution or a silently-spliced two-span quote), never a role or identity conflict; none blocks admission of a row whose placement clears the independent all-VERIFIED-evidence path.

No money-corner link exists on this chain (heat.money_corner is False on all 11 links; capture never clears 60 anywhere). Priority order worked: the five CHOKE_POINT links first (us-black-mass-refining impact 85, recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout impact 80, us-tungsten-processing-and-carbide-production impact 78, us-critical-minerals-domestic-allocation-rule impact 92 and national-defense-stockpile-and-title-iii-funding impact 85, the last two EXHAUSTED at 0 issuers by chain design), then the remaining links by impact (black-mass-production 78, tungsten-ore-and-scrap-feedstock 75, displaced-non-us-buyers 48, defense-and-industrial-tungsten-demand 45, ev-and-grid-battery-material-demand 32, spent-battery-feedstock 20).

RESULT: 5 rows seated across 5 distinct issuers (of 7 mapped), under 3 distinct link_ids. Method section 6's single-row-under-highest-priority-link rule means an issuer placed on more than one link is listed once, under its highest-priority (money-corner, then CHOKE_POINT-by-impact, then impact) link, with the other link(s) named in the row's secondary_links and thesis_1line, so several CHOKE_POINT/high-impact links carry real, evidenced exposure without a row of their own.

us-black-mass-refining [CHOKE_POINT, impact 85, verdict EMERGING]: 3 rows seated (ABAT, PKX, ELBM), all all-VERIFIED evidence. AQMS is placed here too (INFERRED evidence, no placement_audit for this exact link; its only placement_audits[] entry, on the sibling recycling link, FAILed) and is excluded.

recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout [CHOKE_POINT, impact 80, verdict UNDISCOVERED, TARGET_MET at 5/5 in the mapping's own census]: KMT seated here (all-VERIFIED evidence, despite a FAIL placement_audit on this exact triple whose finding does not touch role or identity). ABAT, PKX and ELBM are also placed here but each already seated under the higher-priority us-black-mass-refining link (impact 85 > 80) per the dedup rule; AQMS is excluded (INFERRED evidence, FAIL placement_audit).

us-tungsten-processing-and-carbide-production [CHOKE_POINT, impact 78, verdict CROWDED]: 1 placement, KMT, all-VERIFIED evidence and independently admissible, but KMT is already seated under recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout (impact 80 > 78) per the dedup rule, so this link carries KMT's exposure via the secondary_links field on that row rather than a row of its own. Genuinely zero OTHER issuers on this link in the mapping's own census (OPEN at 1/10).

us-critical-minerals-domestic-allocation-rule [CHOKE_POINT, impact 92, verdict CROWDED]: searched and empty by chain design. The mapping's own EXHAUSTED record (two sources, sec.gov EDGAR full-text search and hklaw.com legal analysis, both control-probe-passed) confirms the link IS the BIS Temporary Final Rule itself, a federal mechanism with no corporate issuer of its own; not a mapping defect.

tungsten-ore-and-scrap-feedstock [HIGH bottleneck, impact 75, verdict CROWDED]: 1 row seated (ALMONTY, all-VERIFIED evidence). GUARDIAN-METAL is the link's only other placement (INFERRED evidence from a company website, no placement_audit) and is excluded.

The mapping's own note records 0 issuers placed this run: real candidates (Umicore, Glencore, two China-listed names) could not be resolved against a fetchable static identity source (Euronext Brussels, LSE, SSE/SZSE all serve JS-rendered pages). data_gaps: AQMS (COMPLETE O2 profile, T1) is blocked purely on evidence tier: both its placements carry a single INFERRED item (an Investing.com article), and its one placement_audit (recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout, 2026-09-14) FAILed on a contiguity defect rather than clearing the bar. A fresh `run universe` pass re-citing AQMS's role against a VERIFIED primary source (an SEC filing rather than a news article), or a PASS placement_audit on either of its two placements, would seat it; it is the most valuable single unblock on this chain since it sits on the same money-adjacent link as ABAT, PKX and ELBM.

GUARDIAN-METAL (COMPLETE O2 profile, T3) is blocked on evidence tier: its sole placement (tungsten-ore-and-scrap-feedstock) carries a single INFERRED item sourced to the company's own website (project pages), not a primary filing or exchange record, and no placement_audit exists for it. A `run universe-audit tungsten-black-mass-lock-in --placement GUARDIAN-METAL` or a re-cite against a VERIFIED source (Guardian Metal Resources is UK/AIM-listed with a Nasdaq ADR per its NYSE-GMTL listing; an official exchange filing would qualify) would seat it and give the thin two-name feedstock link a second row.

KMT carries a FAIL placement_audit on BOTH its links (recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout and us-tungsten-processing-and-carbide-production), dated 2026-09-14. Both FAILs share one root cause: the mapping's evidence[0].source_excerpt splices two genuinely-present, non-adjacent sentences of the same FY2026 10-K into one unbroken quotation with no ellipsis marked (roughly 7,750 characters apart). This did not block either row this run (each placement's evidence tag is VERIFIED independent of the audit outcome, and the auditor's own text affirms the underlying role claim), but the mapping citation itself should be re-split into two genuine spans per method section 1's tabular/composite allowance, an Atlas action on data/mappings/tungsten-black-mass-lock-in.json, not a screen action.

PKX carries the same shape of FAIL placement_audit on recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout (a slide-deck exhibit's run-on text spliced across a dropped chart and several slide phrases, with a fabricated period inserted). Same non-blocking, non-fabricated finding; same re-citation action for Atlas, not this screen.

us-tungsten-processing-and-carbide-production, black-mass-production and defense-and-industrial-tungsten-demand each carry a real, admissible placement (KMT, ABAT, KMT respectively) that is not seated as its own row because method section 6's dedup rule lists an issuer once under its higher-priority link; their exposure is recorded in the relevant row's secondary_links and thesis_1line rather than lost. This is expected behavior, not a coverage gap, but is named here so link-yield accounting is not misread as those three links producing nothing.

displaced-non-us-buyers, ev-and-grid-battery-material-demand and spent-battery-feedstock remain genuinely OPEN at 0 issuers in the mapping's own census (not proved EXHAUSTED): the mapping's notes attribute this to JS-rendered exchange pages (Euronext Brussels, LSE, SSE/SZSE) and unverifiable Korean/Japanese listings this run's fetch tools could not resolve, and to a chain-design decision (collection has no standalone ticker) respectively. A follow-on `run universe` pass with a JS-capable fetch path could close these.

changelog.change: First run screen tungsten-black-mass-lock-in (chain-level, scenario_id null). Built the per-link universe across all 11 links under audit_scope PLACEMENT (mapping ACTIVE, empty audit block, no census audit). Of 14 placements across 7 distinct issuers, 11 (across 5 issuers: ABAT, KMT, PKX, ELBM, ALMONTY) carry all-VERIFIED role evidence and are admissible; 3 (AQMS x2, GUARDIAN-METAL x1) carry INFERRED-only evidence and stay blocked, AQMS despite a same-day placement_audit that FAILed on a citation-contiguity defect rather than clearing the bar. All 5 admissible issuers already hold COMPLETE O2 profiles. Seated 5 rows, one per admissible issuer under method section 6's dedup rule (an issuer on multiple links is listed once, under its highest-priority link: no money-corner link exists on this chain, so priority runs CHOKE_POINT-by-impact then impact; the other links are recorded in each row's secondary_links and thesis_1line). Result: 3 pure_play (ABAT, ELBM, ALMONTY), 1 picks_and_shovels (KMT), 1 second_order (PKX), 0 hedge. All 5 rows carry at least one verbatim earnings nugget (ABAT and KMT carry two, ALM carries two) verified against data/edgar/docs/<T>.json this run. No PENDING_DATA rows: all needed market and EDGAR data was already on disk. Documented every link's disposition, including the two EXHAUSTED-by-design CHOKE_POINT mechanism links, in universe_note; named the evidence-tier blockers (AQMS, GUARDIAN-METAL) and the two same-day FAIL placement_audits that did not block seated rows (KMT, PKX) in data_gaps.
